title: Parabolically induced representations of $GL_n(O_l)$
summary: Let $\mathcal O$ be the ring of integers of a non-Archimedean local field with uniformizer $\varpi$, and let $\mathcal O_\ell=\mathcal O/\varpi^\ell\mathcal O$ for $\ell\geq1$. In this article, we study representations of $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathcal O_\ell)$ parabolically induced from characters of the Borel subgroup $\mathrm{B}_n(\mathcal O_\ell)$. For $n=3$, we establish a criterion for the irreducibility of these induced representations in terms of the relative conductors of the inducing characters.
